newsitem.title: GERMANY: Viag confirms interest in Bewag, Elektrowatt.
newsitem.headline: Viag confirms interest in Bewag, Elektrowatt.

text.p: German diversified industrial group Viag AG confirmed it was interested in increasing its stake in German utility Bewag AG and was also interested in Swiss group Elektrowatt.
Viag along with German diversified utility Veba AG already has a 10 percent stake in Bewag, which is still majority-owned by the state of Berlin.
Other groups, including British electricity generator PowerGen Plc, have also expressed an interest in Bewag.
Viag chief executive Georg Obermeier told a news briefing late on Wednesday that he believed Viag and Veba had a good chance of securing a further stake in Bewag.
An offer from the two for the 25.8 percent stake up for sale by the Berlin state is expected on Friday.
Obermeier further confirmed that Viag was interested in taking a stake in Elektrowatt, saying Viag saw the Swiss energy sector as particularly attractive.
Shares in the Swiss industrial and utility group have recently risen on speculation that bank group CS Holding is to sell its 44.9 percent stake in it by the year-end.
